title: Which registration path the gateway takes (simulation)
lede: Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. The deck says the MCP specification prefers CIMD over dynamic registration and that the gateway offers both. The choice and the fallback are the lab's reading.

nodes.label: Registration endpoint
sub: Offered by the gateway: deck claim
Used when CIMD is not available: lab reading

steps.title: Read the discovery metadata
steps.what: Deck claim: the gateway advertises CIMD support in its discovery metadata, and publishes metadata so compliant clients connect without custom configuration.

steps.title: Choose a path
steps.what: Lab reading: when the gateway advertises CIMD and the client presents a document URL, CIMD is taken. The deck states that the MCP specification prefers CIMD over dynamic registration.

steps.title: Allowlist, fetch, validate, cache
steps.what: Deck claim: the client identifies itself by a document URL the tenant has allowlisted, and the gateway fetches, validates and caches it. The order of the checks and the validation rules are lab-invented.

steps.title: Otherwise dynamic registration
steps.what: Lab reading: a client with no document URL, or a gateway that does not advertise CIMD, registers dynamically. The deck lists dynamic client registration as part of the gateway's authorization server.
